title: Как ответить на первый заказ
script: Урок четыре. Нашёл заказ? Покажи клиенту, что понял задачу, как её выполнишь и какой результат он получит.

mastering.warmthEq: +2.0 dB around 175 Hz; +0.7 dB around 520 Hz
mastering.deEssEq: -1.35 dB around 6.2 kHz plus gentle de-esser

video.ambience: very subtle continuous technology room tone under speech and after narration

rules: Never call espeak, an iPhone system voice, or another fallback Irina.
Match the Liza reference by using short connected micro-pauses rather than hard silence.
Soften phrase endings; no clicks or abrupt waveform cuts.
Preserve Irina identity while matching Liza-style warmth, pitch range, tempo and pause feel.
No paid TTS credits are required for this preset.
